no_connections: No connections recorded for this verse.
search_hint: Words or a reference, e.g. Jn 3:16
no_bookmarks: No bookmarks yet. Open a verse and tap the ribbon to keep it here.
canon_note: The Bible tab shows the books of your canon. Meqabyan (1–3) for the Tewahedo canon follows once a freely licensed translation is found.
related_verses_note: Verses most strongly linked to the key verses by the OpenBible.info cross-references.
fallback_kjv: Not in this translation, shown in English.
ev_meskel: Meskel · Finding of the True Cross
ev_nebiyat: Tsome Nebiyat · Fast of the Prophets
ev_hawaryat: Tsome Hawaryat · Fast of the Apostles
ev_filseta_fast: Tsome Filseta · Fast of the Assumption
ev_m_medhanealem: Medhane Alem · Saviour of the World
weekdays: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun
greg_months: January February March April May June July August September October November December
calendar_note: Feasts and fasts of the Ethiopian and Eritrean Orthodox Tewahedo Church. Local customs may differ.
original_hint: From the King James Version’s Strong’s numbers. Tap a word for its meaning and other verses.
fathers_none: No commentary from the Church Fathers on this verse in the collection yet.
fathers_note: Commentary from public-domain English translations: the Ante-Nicene and Nicene/Post-Nicene Fathers (Schaff, 1885–1900), Newman’s Catena Aurea (1841–45) and Pusey’s Cyril of Alexandria. Gathered by the HistoricalChristianFaith Commentaries Database. Years show when each father died.
no_highlights: No highlights yet. Open a verse and tap a colour.
no_notes: No notes yet. Open a verse and tap “Note”.
backup_auto_none: No automatic backup yet. The app keeps one each week once you have bookmarks, highlights or notes.
backup_import_body: This backup {date} contains {items}. They are added to what is on this phone; entries for the same verse are replaced. Nothing else is removed.
not_backup: This file is not a Scripture Links backup.
backup_newer: This backup comes from a newer version of the app. Please update the app first.
backup_note: Your bookmarks, highlights and notes stay on this phone. Save or share a backup to keep them safe or move them to a new phone. The app also keeps the last four weekly backups on the phone.
packs_note: Packs are downloaded once and then work offline. Each download is checked before it is used.
packs_offline: The list of packs could not be loaded. Check the internet connection and try again.
pack_checksum: The download was damaged and was not installed. Please try again.
pack_failed: The download failed. Check the connection and try again.
pack_remove_confirm: Remove this pack and free {size}? You can download it again at any time.
pack_needed_fathers: Commentary of the Church Fathers comes as a download pack (about 9 MB).
pack_needed_words: Hebrew and Greek words come as a download pack (about 7 MB).
no_memory: No memory verses yet. Add a pack above, or tap “Memorize” on any verse.
memory_swipe_hint: Swipe a verse to the left to remove it.
recall_prompt: Say or type the verse from memory.
accuracy: {pct} % of the words in the right order
how_well: How well did you know it?
reminder_at: Every day at {time}, when verses are due
reminder_hint: A notification when verses are due
reminder_blocked: Notifications are turned off for Scripture Links. Allow them in Android settings.
reminder_offer_body: Verses stay in memory when you review them on the right day. Get a notification at {time} on days when verses are due? You can change this later under Memory verses.
tradition_note: Decides which books (canon) and which tradition-specific content you see. You can still change the canon below.
tradition_general_desc: What all Christians share. The 66 books every church accepts.
tradition_tewahedo_desc: Ethiopian and Eritrean Orthodox. 81 books, the church calendar and feasts.
tradition_orthodox_desc: Greek, Russian and other Orthodox churches.
tradition_protestant_desc: Evangelical, Lutheran, Reformed and other churches. 66 books.
welcome_sub: Verses by topic, the links between the Old and New Testament, and the Church Fathers.
welcome_later: You can change both later in Settings.
answers_intro: Answers in the words of the Bible, the Creed, the Church Fathers, the catechisms and other sources. Tap a quote to open its source and read it for yourself.
no_saved_answers: No saved answers yet. Tap the bookmark on an answer to keep it here.
unreviewed_note: Not yet reviewed by clergy. Every point rests on the verses and sources shown; please read them for yourself.
source_note: Opens in your browser and needs an internet connection. The archived copy helps if the page has moved.
link_failed: The link could not be opened.
report_source: The source does not support this
report_note: Opens your share menu, so you can choose how to send the report.
evidence_intro: Archaeological finds and ancient historians that mention people, places and events of the Bible, in the words of the sources. Tap a quote to read the source.
evidence_note: Evidence like this shows that people and places of the Bible are historical; it does not prove matters of faith. Where scholars disagree, the objection is shown too.
legal_contact_missing: (to be added before the app is published)
